items.text: Henri B. Kagan and Kensō Soai are awarded the Nobel Prize in Chemistry for the discovery of non-linear effects and autocatalysis in asymmetric organic synthesis.
Francis Halzen is awarded the Nobel Prize in Physics for his work in neutrino astronomy.
In motorsport, Elfyn Evans and Scott Martin win the World Rally Championship.
